def json_object(value: object) -> JsonObject:

def model_values(model: BaseModel, *, exclude_unset: bool = False) -> dict[str, FieldValue]:


    """Model values."""
    return FIELD_VALUES.validate_python(model.model_dump(exclude_unset=exclude_unset), strict=True)

def create_router(session_provider: Callable[[], Iterator[Session]]) -> APIRouter:
    """Create router."""
    router = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(require_access)])

    def require_parent(db: Session, parent_id: int) -> Parent:

        """Require parent."""
        row = db.get(Parent, parent_id)
        if row is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="parent not found")
        return row

    def _require_child(db: Session, parent_id: int, child_id: int) -> Child:

        """ require child."""
        require_parent(db, parent_id)
        row = db.scalar(select(Child).where(Child.id == child_id, Child.{{foreign_key}} == parent_id))
        if row is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="child not found")
        return row

    def integrity_failure(db: Session, exc: IntegrityError, missing_parent: bool = False) -> Never:

        """Integrity failure."""
        db.rollback()
        code = getattr(exc.orig, "sqlstate", None)
        if code == "23503" and missing_parent:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="parent not found") from exc
        if code in {"23503", "23505"}:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="relationship or unique value conflict") from exc
        raise exc

        return await run_in_threadpool(read)

        """ workflow import."""
        def write() -> list[JsonObject]:
